quarterly_data.quarter: IonQ press release: IonQ's Superion 256 Platform Selected by Florida (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IonQ signed a contract with Florida International University (FIU) to deliver its sixth-generation Superion 256-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer for installation at FIU - IonQ's first sale and deployment of a Superion 256 in Florida - in a secure facility on the FIU campus, with installation currently expected in late 2027 after FIU's on-campus data center is completed; FIU becomes IonQ's preferred university partner in Florida.
quarterly_data.figure: 1 Superion 256 system; installation expected in late 2027
